root_frozen.report_notes: ACL unremarkable. MCL sprain has thickening and increased signal without stated grade/fiber percentage; retain uncertain rather than automatically assuming all ungraded sprains are low grade. MPFL retinacular sprain is separate. Both menisci and TF cartilage explicitly preserved. PF section gives marrow, alignment, tendons/retinacula but no cartilage assessment. Significant fluid absence qualified. Normal marrow is explicitly recorded for both TF compartments and patella, supporting contusion negative. No definite plica does not assess synovial inflammation, and normal fat pad does not fill it. No Baker or fracture-specific finding. Preserve literal tendon0 and TNC/NAW wording without repair.

root_frozen.report_notes: ACL unremarkable. MCL sprain has thickening and increased signal without stated grade/fiber percentage; retain uncertain rather than automatically assuming all ungraded sprains are low grade. MPFL retinacular sprain is separate. Both menisci and TF cartilage explicitly preserved. PF section gives marrow, alignment, tendons/retinacula but no cartilage assessment. Significant fluid absence qualified. Normal marrow is explicitly recorded for both TF compartments and patella, supporting contusion negative. No definite plica does not assess synovial inflammation, and normal fat pad does not fill it. No Baker or fracture-specific finding. Preserve literal tendon0 and TNC/NAW wording without repair.
